verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents charging shoppers in their preferred currencies with local payment methods via the Multi-Currency Pricing API and 160+ local methods. Funds settle like-for-like into a natively multi-currency wallet that avoids forced FX fees, and Transfers can then move funds to your own bank accounts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of FX rate and markup transparency, a documented conversion-to-home-currency settlement flow into an external bank, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
